critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1316 lines (grew ~300 lines this phase) — long-term maintainability suffers; strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, campaigns, wallet, admin_kyc, admin_leads, broadcast, notifications, uploads) before Phase 3.

announce_campaign_live() and run_broadcast() fire an outbound email per customer in a background task with no rate-limit / concurrency cap — a fan-out over 5000+ customers will serialize and can exceed Resend rate limits. Consider asyncio.gather with a semaphore (e.g. 10) or a task queue.
@app.on_event('startup') and @app.on_event('shutdown') are deprecated in modern FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
No brute-force lockout / rate limiting on /api/auth/login (playbook non-conformance); recommend adding a per-email + per-IP counter with 5-fail 15-minute lockout.
/api/upload only validates the client-supplied Content-Type; add magic-byte sniffing (e.g. imghdr / python-magic) to prevent malicious uploads disguised as image/*.
/api/notifications/read empty body is treated as 'mark all' — this is fine, but the endpoint should be POST /notifications/read-all separately or documented clearly to avoid confusion.
admin_broadcast fan-out to unverified customers is filtered out (email_verified: True) — correct; document this so admins understand why 'Sending to N' N may be lower than total customers count.
